# Career Strategy — Asha Verma  *(illustrative, anonymized sample)*

> Fictional example of a Phase P6 strategy doc: market read, honest odds, sequenced plan. Comp numbers are directional placeholders — always verify. Replace on a real run.

## Direction
Lead as an **Applied-AI Engineer** with a cloud-native backbone. The market rewards "engineer who ships real AI," and that's the true shape of this history.

## Role read (directional)
| Direction | Who hires | Odds | Comp signal* |
|---|---|---|---|
| Backend SWE | product/SaaS | High | baseline |
| Cloud/DevOps/SRE | cloud-heavy | High | high |
| Applied AI/GenAI | AI-first scaleups | High & rising | very high |
| Architect | enterprises | Medium | high |

\* Directional only — verify per-company on levels.fyi / Glassdoor.

## Honest gaps & how to close
- No marquee-brand employer yet → ship **one flagship open-source AI project** with a write-up; collect referrals.
- Interview rust → a focused **DSA + system-design + AI-system-design** sprint (see interview-prep).

## Sequence (6–12 months)
1. **Now–M1:** profile + résumé toolkit live; recruiters-only visibility on.
2. **M1–4:** flagship OSS AI project + 2–3 posts; one cloud/AI certification.
3. **M4–9:** referral-led applications to AI-first scaleups; 1–2 offers to calibrate.
4. **M9–12:** level up the swing; negotiate from competing interest.
